name: opencode-plugin-ast-lsp
author: deepkolos
description: Standalone AST-grep and LSP tools for OpenCode and Bun CLI

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external typescript && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm --external typescript && bun build src/sdk.ts --outfile dist/sdk.js --target node --format esm --external typescript --external ../ast-grep/downloader && bun build src/sdk.ts --outfile dist/sdk.cjs --target node --format cjs --external typescript --external ../ast-grep/downloader && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('dist/sdk.d.ts', 'dist/sdk.d.cts')"
scripts.test:bunx:pack: bun run build && AST_LSP_CLI_TEST_MODE=bunx-pack bun test test/cli.test.ts
scripts.test:npx:pack: bun run build && AST_LSP_CLI_TEST_MODE=npx-pack bun test test/cli.test.ts
